tiles.body: A pilot, thermocouple, gas valve or element that failed.
Sediment, a broken dip tube or a failing burner.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Problems in Skokie Homes
blocks.intro: Most Skokie water heaters sit in basements built in the 1940s, 50s and 60s, and that shapes the job.

items.body: Many gas water heaters here still vent into the original chimney. If the furnace was upgraded to wall venting, the water heater may not draft well on its own. We check it every time.
Original shutoff valves and connectors are often worn and get replaced during a repair.
Narrow stairs and low beams matter when a heater has to come out.
A leaking heater usually drains to the floor drain, so a slow drain means water spreads.

bodies: We repair gas and electric tank heaters, power-vent models and tankless units in Skokie homes. We test first and recommend second.
When you call, read us the label on the tank: fuel, size and manufacture date. If it's time for a new one, see [water heater installation](/skokie/water-heater-installation).
Flushing the tank once a year clears sediment, keeps the heater efficient and helps it last. We also test the relief valve, check the anode rod and look at the burner and the venting.
Tankless heaters are descaled on a schedule. If your heater has never had service, this is the place to start.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: My water heater vents into the chimney. Is that a problem?
items.preview: It can be, if the furnace no longer shares it.
items.answer: It can be. When a high-efficiency furnace is vented out the wall, the old chimney may be too large for the water heater alone. We test the draft and recommend a fix if needed.

items.q: Is it worth repairing a 12-year-old water heater?
items.answer: Usually not. Past about 12 years, or if the tank is leaking, replacement is the better value.

items.q: Why does my water heater make popping sounds?
items.preview: Sediment on the bottom of the tank.
items.answer: Sediment on the bottom of the tank traps water that boils as the burner fires. Flushing helps if it's not too far gone.

items.q: How long do water heaters last in Skokie?
items.answer: Tank heaters usually last somewhere around 8 to 12 years.

items.q: Why does my water heater smell like rotten eggs?
items.answer: Usually a reaction with the anode rod. Replacing the rod often fixes it.

items.q: How much does water heater repair cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the part and the heater. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what failed and the type of heater. We diagnose it, and you approve a flat-rate price before we start.
